verdict.rationale: An uptime SLA with defined downtime credits is a fair question for a hosting and deployment platform like Netlify, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an SLA, uptime guarantees, or service credits. DDoS protection, rollbacks and performance tracking are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can review a published uptime SLA with defined credits for downtime
